genius.licensingRegulator: Ontario Securities Commission (Canadian prospectus regime for CADC Reserve Trust; not a GENIUS authorization). FINTRAC registers the service entities Loon Payments Inc. and PayTrie AB Inc., not the issuer trust
genius.notes: IssuerEntity corrected from Loon Payments Inc. to CADC Reserve Trust. Paytrie terms amended 2026-10-14 and Loon's current disclosures name CADC Reserve Trust as issuer, and an OSC decision dated 2026-10-22 describes it as a special purpose trust established under the laws of Ontario, originally declared 2023-11-14 by Paytrie as trustee and amended and restated 2026-03-20, with Odyssey Trust Company as trustee. Loon Payments Inc. (Alberta corporation, FINTRAC MSB C10001420, wholly owned by Loon Technology Inc.) is servicer, administrator and promoter of the issuer; Paytrie AB Inc. (FINTRAC M19690633, also a wholly owned Loon Technology subsidiary) operates the Paytrie Platform as an Authorized Participant under a liquidity agreement with the trust. The OSC receipted the trust's final prospectus on 2026-10-22, qualifying continuous distribution of CADC in every Canadian jurisdiction; this is a Canadian securities pathway and does not establish GENIUS authorization. CADC holders redeem through Authorized Participants rather than directly against the trust. The issuer trust holds no FINTRAC MSB registration of its own, and FINTRAC registration is AML context, not a license. The monthly bank-confirmation series still carries no independent accountant opinion or token-supply reconciliation. New CADC contracts on Ethereum, Base, Polygon and Solana are live, the tracked contracts are labeled legacy, and the migration window closes 2026-11-26; Pharos supply still reads the legacy contracts, so issuer and contract continuity across the migration is recorded under followups. GENIUS negative evidence rests on the dated 2026-10-07 review, which found no public GENIUS approval, filing or foreign registration for CADC or the Loon entities.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no public GENIUS permitted-issuer approval, state qualification, official GENIUS application, OCC foreign registration, Treasury issuer/jurisdiction comparability determination or token-specific GENIUS enforcement action was located for CADC, CAD Coin, Loon Technology Inc. and Loon Payments Inc. This is a bounded public-evidence finding, not proof that no nonpublic filing exists. Foreign-exception eligibility remains unknown; existing foreign AML, banking or corporate status does not establish GENIUS approval.
